articles.title: Ram Temple Donation Case: Trust Treasurer Responds to Accountability Questions
articles.description: In the ongoing Ram Temple donation theft controversy, questions were raised over the responsibility of trust officials, including the treasurer, regarding alleged irregularities in donation management. During an interaction with ABP News, the treasurer was questioned about whether he accepted any responsibility for the situation. He responded that every member of the trust has some responsibility, including him, but clarified that his role was limited to maintaining accounts of funds received and that he was not involved in the physical counting of donations collected through hundis. When asked about resigning, he denied any reason to step down, stating that the matter was unrelated to his assigned duties. The discussion comes amid the SIT investigation into alleged theft of temple offerings, with officials facing scrutiny over supervision and management failures. The trust has stated that further decisions will be taken after the complete SIT report is submitted. The investigation continues, with questions remaining about accountability and the roles of various officials involved in the temple’s donation management system.
